card.name: Verbs after 'whether to' or 'do not'
card.fires_on: The action verb (or 'to') right after a phrase like 'whether or not', 'how long to', 'do not', or 'avoid', where the text is about deciding to do or not do something. Also seen in capitalization style-guide rules.

modes.label: Decision to act
modes.description: Verb or 'to' after 'whether or not' or 'how long to' in treatment decisions.
modes.example: to decide whether or not<< to>> continue acetylcysteine injection

modes.label: Style-guide capitalization
modes.description: Capitalize/lowercase verbs in writing-style rules after 'do not' or 'avoid'.
modes.example: Do not<< capitalize>> as a casual, temporary position.
